src/browser-media-bridge.ts.name: Browser media controls link
src/browser-media-bridge.ts.description: Mirrors what is playing to the browser's system media controls and passes play, pause, next, previous and seek back.

src/browser-media-playback.ts.name: Browser player
src/browser-media-playback.ts.description: Plays approved audio or video bytes, or live audio streams, using the browser's own media elements.

src/browser-media-stream-fetch.ts.name: Live audio fetcher
src/browser-media-stream-fetch.ts.description: Fetches live MP3 or AAC radio-style audio and starts handing it over without waiting for the end.

src/browser-media-stream.ts.name: Live audio buffer
src/browser-media-stream.ts.description: Feeds a fetched live audio stream into the browser player with a size limit and the ability to cancel.

src/media-playback.ts.name: Playback shapes
src/media-playback.ts.description: Describes playback state, commands and session snapshots, and checks commands are valid.

src/media-player.ts.name: Floating media player
src/media-player.ts.description: Shows a small on-screen player with controls for every media session, including video.

src/media-service.ts.name: Media sessions
src/media-service.ts.description: Tracks each napplet's media sessions and playback state, and can play media itself through the shell.
